basis: Source-level assertion review only; no execution is claimed. Native tests under src are included alongside integration tests.

groups.behavior: Timezone queries bypass UTC rollups; quote/space/backslash/newline injection attempts are rejected before SQL.
Both harnesses load tests/native-fixtures/manifest.yml rewrite_queries and assert each sql_contains token after semantic rewrite.
groups.limitation: Compilation/token assertions only; this source test does not execute rewritten SQL.

groups.behavior: origin$countries and destination$countries remain separately scoped join instances; native fixture asserts US/Canada and Canada/France independently.
Named dod/wow/mom/qoq/yoy map to calendar intervals without a declared grain; month result regression independently verifies sparse periods and category partitions.
groups.limitation: All five intervals have native unit assertions; the dual-engine result counterpart executes month specifically.

groups.behavior: Year-to-date window partitions on calendar year rather than retaining prior-year rows.
groups.limitation: Native counterpart asserts emitted calendar-year partition/frame; it is not a result-level duplicate of the original fixture.

groups.behavior: Fill applies to final cumulative/comparison/offset-ratio result; empty/prior-missing periods use the declared default instead of feeding a filled base value into the temporal operation.
Model leaf defaults are used by direct, derived and ratio dependencies; null groups/empty aggregates retain explicit defaults.
Month comparison subtracts the matching prior calendar month within each category and yields null across a missing month.
Model-local conversion metric selects distinct signup entities and counts purchases within an inclusive seven-day window; late purchases do not convert.
groups.limitation: Python graph auto-registration bookkeeping remains Python-owned; the public native fixture tests model-local resolution and results.

groups.behavior: Model-local retention executes with a fixed cohort/period/active_users/cohort_size/percentage schema.
Zero retention periods are rejected instead of silently defaulting to 28.

Model-local inner count-distinct/HAVING cohort qualification preserves outer dimension/time-grain names; outer average reads qualified inner aggregate values, and reserved output dimensions are quoted.
groups.limitation: Counterparts cover the same operations with independent synthetic populations; graph-owner inference is explicitly excluded from this mapping.

groups.behavior: Explicit Python route override and monkeypatched Python _rewrite_python RuntimeError propagation test the legacy implementation contract, not a missing native semantic query feature.
Timing thresholds and warm-cache comparisons directly benchmark Python SQLGenerator/QueryRewriter objects; these are not correctness exclusions or proof of native performance.
Python infers the unique source model from the graph-level cohort entity without metric_owners. Rust strict graph scope requires an explicit cohort owner and rejects this valid Python shape.
groups.limitation: Counterpart is negative evidence: mutation=unowned is intentionally rejected. SemanticLayer.add_metric does not supply an owner, and graph_to_semantic_input preserves that absence. Source-confirmed; live repro remains lead-owned.
